exposure: pregnancy weight gain (first trimester, second trimester, pre-OGTT)
outcome: admission to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: Women with singleton pregnancies who had a first visit at Fujian Maternity and Child Health Hospital before 14 weeks and delivered after 28 weeks.
finding: Inadequate first-trimester weight gain is significantly associated with a reduced risk of gestational diabetes mellitus, particularly in younger women, women with normal or low pre-pregnancy BMI, elevated fasting glucose, and low HDL or triglycerides, without increasing the risk of abnormal neonatal birth weight.
